PMP-certified Project Manager with over 18 years of global experience leading complex, compliance-driven technology initiatives across healthcare, telecom, and government sectors. Proven expertise in delivering security audit programs, cloud infrastructure transformations, and regulatory modernization projects aligned with NIST 800-53, HIPAA, and IRS Pub 1075 standards.

Adept at managing full project lifecycles—from initiation through execution and closure—ensuring scope, time, cost, and quality objectives are consistently met. Skilled in collaborating with diverse stakeholders including federal agencies, vendors, engineers, and legal teams to execute mission-critical programs with audit precision and operational excellence.

Track record includes leading enterprise-wide EHR modernization, regulatory compliance rollouts, and security control implementations for high-stakes environments. Strong command over PMO frameworks, risk management, and governance reporting, with executive-level communication skills and hands-on mastery of MS Project, SharePoint, Power BI, and O365.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams including data scientists, UX designers, and legal/compliance officers to implement AI/ML pipelines for lab data processing, ticket triage, and regulatory documentation.

Developed compliance dashboards and executive reports using Power BI to support pharmacovigilance monitoring and secure audit logs.

Familiar with pharma-adjacent systems and concepts including Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS), Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), electronic Trial Master File (eTMF), and Electronic Data Capture (EDC).

Participated in planning and governance of digital health programs that intersected with clinical research workflows, regulatory mandates, and FDA audit trails.

Directed cross-functional teams to implement corrective action plans post-security assessments.

Tracked milestones in MS Project and managed document repository on SharePoint 2013.

Conducted stakeholder briefings and project closeout reviews with executive sponsors.

Governance & Standardization: Ensured adherence to PMO governance frameworks, standardizing project management practices across multiple programs. Maintained compliance with Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid project methodologies.

Applied PMI-standard Project Lifecycle Framework (Initiation to Closure) across enterprise programs, ensuring structured project planning, governance alignment, and rigorous execution in compliance-driven environments

Project Tracking & Reporting: Developed and maintained dashboards to track KPIs, project progress, issue logs, and risk mitigation strategies. Generated executive reports to provide visibility into program health and budget utilization.

Proven Program Manager role with a strong track record of leading large-scale PLM-aligned initiatives across telecom, IT, and infrastructure domains—driving projects from concept through execution, including fiber rollouts, core network builds, and enterprise ERP transformations.

Financial & Resource Management: Assisted in project budgeting, financial forecasting, and resource allocation to optimize delivery efficiency. Monitored CAPEX/OPEX expenditures to ensure alignment with business goals and financial controls.

Stakeholder & Communication Management: Acted as a bridge between business stakeholders, IT teams, and vendors to align project execution with strategic goals. Facilitated executive-level communication through structured reporting and analysis.

Process Improvement & Compliance: Led process improvement initiatives to streamline project workflows and enhance operational efficiency. Ensured compliance with regulatory requirements, including risk assessments for IT and telecom projects.

Delivered executive-level presentations and reporting to C-suite stakeholders (CIO, CFO), and led steering committee sessions to drive alignment, risk resolution, and decision-making across cross-functional teams

Extensively worked on Python in Synapse notebooks for the past 6 years.

Built dataflows in Mulesoft, performed mappings and transformations to extract data and write to Confluent Kafka topics.

Worked on Informatica (v9) to load the Clinical Trial Management System’s data into a warehouse.

Leveraged Cloud formation templates to automate instantiation of EC2 instances (redhat linux) and deploy the registry application (java, spring mvc, reactjs) backed by Oracle in RDS (multi zone for HA).

Designed and built various integrations leveraging ETL tools and AWS services, some of which included EC2, S3 storage, Talend, Kafka managed service, RDS (Oracle), EMR (spark), AWS Lambda, AWS glue and Snowflake.

Built a reconciliation framework using Athena to find any missing data/updates between the registry application and the DWH.

Was involved in the installation of Talend ETL job and ESB servers. Built Talend ETL jobs and routes to consume the feed from the registry application from ActiveMQ queues, parse the dataset and load it into Oracle database.

Built various ETL jobs in Talend to load data for migrating the on prem data to RDS (oracle). These were run on the Talend job servers.

Created the design for Leads, Customers, Activities and documented the same in Technical Specification documents based on the specs provided.

Validated the components developed by the offshore team and made sure they followed Siebel best practices and performed Unit Test reviews.

Configured Integration Objects and Business Service. Created an Inbound WebService which contains Siebel port/transport information and generated a WSDL out of it. Oracle Service Bus imports this WSDL and uses the port information to submit XMLs to CELTRAK.









Configured error handling for workflows by sending an email automatically using the ‘Outbound Communication Manager’ to the admin whenever an exception happens in workflows. This process is generic to all Interfaces.

Installed the Siebel Charts Server and made the Siebel Charts functionality available for Protocols, Countries (Region), Contracts and Sites.





CRM Consultant

https://bluecrossnc.com Responsibilities:

Designed and developed the data model/configuration for Tracking Experience module for Large Group Opportunities (Account Opportunities). Each Tracking Experience would have a Program and Solution associated with it. This functionality was achieved by cloning the out of the box Product Line/Product model.

Developed the Custom Business Component for Tracking experiences based on the Source table in Siebel and cloned the Product Line/Internal Product BCs for Programs and Solutions respectively.

Configured List/Form/Pick Applets, Views, Screens for displaying the Tracking Experiences, Programs and Solutions information under Large Group Opportunities (Account/Oppty).

Scripted the Custom Business Service to call a workflow which in turn creates the request property set, converts it to XML, then calls the proxy business service which in-turn triggers the webservice call via HTTP and gets back the response from OneView. The response gets past a bunch of business rules in the workflow, then formatted and displayed on the Siebel UI.

Followed Siebel Best practices while scripting and configuring workflows considering Performance with VBC and WebService calls.

Federal Student Aid (Perot Systems Govt Services) | Fairfax, VA



01/2008 – 09/2008

https://studentaid.gov Responsibilities:

Created Workflows that would trigger based out of workflow policies and process the school application information submitted by the School (Partner). The workflow would use Siebel Operation steps and Custom business services which perform the data validation and do the insert/update in Channel Partner.

Worked on the Opportunity Proposal module to dynamically generate Siebel data into word documents. In the process, created the Word templates with Bookmark fields and created the bookmark to field mappings between Opportunity and its child Business Components.

Designed and implemented an UI/interface with IBM’s FileNet which provides the central document storage facility. All the documents like attachments and PPA documents generated from Siebel Proposal module are uploaded to FileNet using a Java based UI that’s exposed in Siebel using Symbolic URL. The documents are shared between Siebel and FileNet using a unique Id(Activity Id). The documents are displayed as links in a separate View, so user can view/download them from Siebel.

Developed an outbound webservice interfacing with EPLS(Excluded Parties List System) (https://www.epls.gov/ ) to run the Debarment for Partner Users(Contacts). In the process consumed the EPLS WSDL and created a workflow. Using the Integration Object imported through the WSDL I performed the UI Data mapping between the Siebel Integration Object and the external Integration Object. After which I call the webservice which posts the XML using HTTP Transport and gets back the response code and message which get updated at the Partner-Contact level.





















CRM Integration Consultant

Merck Pharmaceuticals | West Point, PA



08/2006 – 12/2007

https://merck.com Responsibilities:

Designed and Developed an Inbound interface with Customer Master (Siperian). This process Pub-Sub, where Customer Master publishes and Cornerstone (Siebel) subscribes for information.

This interface uses Tibco Siebel Adapter as the middleware, where Tibco plays a role in modifying and transporting the data in the form of XML. But no business rules are applied in Tibco. The logic is implemented in Siebel.

Designed and developed two interfaces with CIR (Customer Interaction Repository), one inbound and one outbound. The inbound interface is called 'CIR Get' and the outbound 'Cir Add/Update'.

Performed EIM jobs to import and cleanup data. Built the IFBs needed for the EIM jobs. Automated the EIM jobs making it easy for other developers to run it just on a mouse click. Informatica was used to load Siebel EIM tables with Customer Master data from flat files.





CRM Consultant

Janssen Pharmaceutical Companies of J&J | Titusville, NJ



07/2005 - 07/2006

https://janssen.com/us Responsibilities:

Involved in the Business requirements. Defined the source to target mappings and the business rules.

Developed the workflows and workflow policies required for Outbound Integration, which included build of workflow policy object, columns and programs.

Worked on the server-side tasks required for accepting the Incoming XMLs on to the WebServer from the Webmethods canonical like creating named subsystems and setting the business services to invoke the workflows.









Designed, documented and published Data Mappings based on the business requirements, required columns, User Keys and LOV values using Siebel Tools, EIM tables and Base Tables.

Loaded the data from VPIL tables to EIM Staging tables using customized tool through TOAD.





CRM Integration Consultant

One Call Care Medical | Parsipanny, NJ



04/2005 – 06/2005

https://onecallcm.com Responsibilities:

Extensively involved in Configuration of Accounts and Contacts Interface elements for the GUI.

Designed workflows in Siebel Tools (New in 7.7) and used vanilla Siebel adapters and custom business services.

Used the Siebel EAI Data Mapper to map Internal and External Integration Objects in Siebel Client.

Designed individual workflows for Contacts like patient, doctor, physician, agent, adjuster and Accounts like payer, employer, and company.

Also created major workflows based on the base tables, which call the above workflows as sub processes.



Web Developer

Sify India Pvt. Limited | Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India



11/2002 - 11/2004

https://sifytechnologies.com Responsibilities:

Designing and Development of UIs for Sify Channels and for various products offered by the company.

Involved in creating web advertisements like animated banners, text banners, popup advertisements, shoshkeles, insliders and interstitials to increase the Ad revenue by getting more click thrus on the 67 Sify Channels.

Specialized in designing Microsites for clients like Standard Chartered, HDFC, ICICI, Citibank and various other organizations and their products.

Designing the showcasing images and icons on Sify webpages which will lead to other channels.

resumeText:
Reddy				                      (+1) 223 356 3459



Professional Summary

 Seasoned Data Engineering leader with over 12 years of experience in designing, developing, and optimizing large-scale data platforms across Microsoft Azure and AWS, driving data-driven transformation in complex enterprise environments

Specialized in building secure, high-performance data ecosystems that integrate on-premises, hybrid, and cloud-native systems for analytics, reporting, and decision support at scale.

Architected end-to-end data solutions leveraging Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Databricks, and Data Lake Storage Gen2 to enable seamless data ingestion, transformation, and orchestration.

Implemented scalable, serverless data pipelines on AWS using AWS Glue, Athena, Redshift, and S3, delivering optimized and cost-efficient data processing frameworks.

Expert in data lakehouse architectures and Delta Lake design, ensuring ACID compliance, schema evolution, and efficient incremental processing for both batch and streaming data workloads.

Proficient in PySpark and Spark SQL programming, optimizing large-scale distributed data transformations, joins, and aggregations for high-volume datasets.

Advanced SQL and T-SQL development expertise, crafting efficient stored procedures, functions, and indexing strategies to ensure exceptional query performance and scalability.

Led multiple successful cloud migration initiatives, transitioning legacy systems to Azure SQL, Snowflake, and Data Lake platforms while ensuring minimal downtime and zero data loss.

Designed normalized, denormalized, and dimensional data models including star, snowflake, and data vault schemas to support both transactional and analytical workloads.

Developed robust, automated ETL/ELT frameworks using Azure Data Factory, SSIS, and Logic Apps with built-in error handling, logging, and retry capabilities for operational reliability.

Integrated continuous integration and deployment pipelines using Azure DevOps, enabling automated testing, version control, and rapid deployment across development environments.

Delivered enterprise-grade BI and reporting solutions using Power BI and SSRS, creating intuitive dashboards, drill-through reports, and executive analytics for strategic insights.

Collaborated with cross-functional business teams to translate analytical requirements into scalable data solutions and define KPIs that align with corporate objectives.

Built unified data integration frameworks consolidating structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data from APIs, relational systems, and file-based sources.

Developed high-performance analytical data marts and curated layers to support advanced analytics, forecasting, and machine learning pipelines.

Implemented proactive performance monitoring and alerting systems using Dynamic Management Views (DMVs), Extended Events, and other diagnostic utilities to ensure operational excellence.

Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric ecosystem, integrating OneLake, Dataflows Gen2, and Synapse Data Engineering for next-generation, unified data analytics.

Strong command of data security and compliance practices, including encryption, key management, and access control to ensure governance and regulatory adherence.

Adept at Agile and Scrum methodologies, working closely with engineering, BI, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver iterative, high-quality solutions within tight deadlines.

Dedicated to continuous improvement and innovation, championing automation, process optimization, and adoption of emerging cloud data technologies to enhance business value.

Technical Skills



Category

Skills / Tools / Technologies

Data Engineering & ETL

ASIFA CHEEMA

Senior Healthcare Business Analyst 

Dallas, TX | Cheemaasifa0781@gmail.com | (469) 850-0168 

 Career Summary





Senior Healthcare Business Analyst with 8+ years of progressive experience across provider health systems, Medicaid managed care, and payer operations in the Texas and Michigan healthcare markets, with deep expertise in claims adjudication, member enrollment, benefits configuration, denial management, and prior authorization workflows.

Led requirements workshops, authored BRDs/FRDs, facilitated JAD sessions, and served as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and IT development teams for claims system implementations on Facets, Epic, and state Medicaid platforms across Medicaid, Medicare, and commercial product lines.

Hands-on experience with EDI transaction processing and configuration (837P/I, 835, 834, 270/271, 276/277), CARC/RARC denial analytics, HIPAA 5010 compliance, and HL7 interface support for claims, enrollment, and eligibility operations.

Strong technical foundation in SQL-based claims data analysis, process modeling (BPMN, UML), UAT coordination, and stakeholder management using JIRA, Azure DevOps, MS Visio, and Confluence within Agile/Scrum and Waterfall delivery models.

Certified Scrum Master (CSM) with demonstrated ability to manage sprint backlogs, facilitate Agile ceremonies, and drive cross-functional alignment across claims operations, clinical informatics, provider relations, and compliance teams.

technical SKILLS 



Healthcare Domain

Claims Adjudication, Member Enrollment, Benefits Configuration, Provider Data Management, Prior Authorization, COB, Utilization Management, Denial Management, Medical Coding (ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS), Grievance & Appeals

EDI Transactions

837P/I, 835, 834, 270/271, 276/277, 278, ANSI X12, HIPAA 5010, HL7/FHIR Interfaces, CARC/RARC Analysis

Regulatory / Compliance

HIPAA, CMS Guidelines, ACA, Texas HHSC Medicaid, Medicare (Parts A, B, C, D), NCQA, HEDIS, PHI/PII Data Governance

BA Methodology

Requirements Elicitation, BRD/FRD, User Stories, Gap Analysis, BPMN/UML Process Modeling, RTM, UAT Planning & Execution, JAD Sessions, SWOT Analysis, Root-Cause Analysis

Healthcare Systems

Facets, Epic (Resolute/Clarity), MMIS, Change Healthcare, Availity, HL7 Interface Engine

Data & Reporting

SQL Server, Oracle, Advanced Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, Power Pivot), Power BI (Basic), SSRS

Tools & Platforms

JIRA, Confluence, MS Visio, SharePoint, Azure DevOps, HP ALM, ServiceNow, MS Project, Rational Rose, ClearQuest

Methodologies

Agile/Scrum (CSM Certified), Waterfall, RUP, SAFe, SDLC, ITIL, Change Management, Release Management

EXPERIENCE 





Senior Healthcare Business Analyst / Project Lead                                               	        September 2023 - Present

Blue Cross Blue Shield of Michigan | Remote

Leading the legacy-to-modern platform assessment and claims system modernization initiative at BCBSM, Michigan's largest health insurer serving 4.4 million members. Conducting discovery workshops across 10+ business areas to document current-state processes, legacy system dependencies, and future-state requirements for the enterprise claims and enrollment platform replacement program. Reported to the VP of Enterprise Systems Transformation.



Led discovery workshops across 10+ business areas (Sales, Provider Management, Claims Enrollment, Claims Processing, Profitability & Cost Management, Senior Health Services, Marketing) to capture current-state processes, system dependencies, and high-level requirements for the legacy platform replacement initiative.

Documented 50+ business process flows using MS Visio covering end-to-end workflows for claims intake, adjudication, enrollment processing, provider credentialing, and benefits configuration, mapping each workflow to underlying legacy system components.

Authored the pre-BRD assessment document consolidating findings from all discovery workshops, presenting current-state pain points, future-state recommendations, and estimated budget/FTE requirements for the data management and reporting modernization.

Managed the RAID log tracking 80+ items across workstreams and facilitated weekly status reviews with the architecture team and project management office.

Worked with the architecture team to evaluate future-state platform options, mapping current Facets claims processing and enrollment capabilities against modern platform alternatives and documenting functional gap assessments.

Coordinated with the QA billing team to validate claims processing accuracy during parallel testing, developing comparison test scenarios for 5 major claim types (professional, institutional, dental, pharmacy, behavioural health).



Healthcare Business Analyst	                                                                                                      July 2021 - August 2023

Texas Health Resources | Arlington, TX | Hybrid

Supported the prior authorization and patient access optimization initiative at Texas Health Resources, the largest health system in North Texas with 29 hospitals and 350+ access points serving 7 million+ residents across the DFW metroplex. Worked with patient access, utilization management, revenue cycle, and IT teams to streamline the prior authorization submission workflow, improve real-time eligibility verification, and reduce authorization-related claim denials. Reported to the Senior Manager of Patient Access Systems.



Gathered and documented business requirements for the prior authorization workflow redesign, facilitating 15+ JAD sessions with utilization management nurses, patient access coordinators, revenue cycle analysts, and payer contracting teams to define system requirements for automated auth submission, status tracking, and determination routing.

Defined 278 prior authorization transaction processing requirements for real-time auth submission to 8 major Texas payers, documenting submission rules, clinical data attachment requirements, and response handling logic for inpatient admissions, outpatient surgical procedures, and advanced imaging services.

Analyzed authorization-related claim denial data across commercial and Medicare Advantage product lines, identifying that 35% of preventable denials were caused by missing or expired authorizations, incorrect procedure-to-auth matching, and retroactive auth gaps, and recommended workflow changes that reduced auth-related denials by 24%.

Defined 270/271 real-time eligibility verification requirements for the patient scheduling and registration workflow, establishing automated benefits check, prior auth status validation, and out-of-network flagging rules to reduce eligibility-related registration errors by 20%.

Mapped As-Is and To-Be BPMN process flows for the authorization lifecycle from initial clinical review request through payer determination, documenting 8 manual handoff points between clinical, UM, patient access, and billing teams targeted for automation.

Built SQL queries against the Epic Clarity database to track authorization turnaround times, approval/denial rates by payer and procedure type, and aged pending authorization volumes, delivering weekly status dashboards in Power BI for UM leadership.

Coordinated UAT across 3 phased releases covering auth workflow automation, eligibility verification enhancements, and payer response integration, developing 140+ test scenarios and managing 30 defects through resolution in JIRA.



Healthcare Business Analyst	                                                                                                      March 2019 - June 2021

UT Southwestern Medical Center | Dallas, TX

Supported the claims billing and revenue cycle operations team at UT Southwestern Medical Center, a $4.5B academic medical center in Dallas. Worked with revenue cycle, coding, enrollment, and compliance teams on Facets claims configuration, EDI transaction processing, and Medicare/Medicaid compliance reporting. Reported to the Director of Revenue Cycle Systems.



Analyzed claims billing and enrollment data using SQL queries against Oracle and SQL Server source systems to identify processing errors, enrollment discrepancies, and billing exceptions across Medicare (Parts A, B, C, D), Medicaid, and commercial payer product lines.

Worked with Facets application groups (Claims Processing, Benefits Configuration, Provider, Subscriber/Member, Utilization Management) to document business rules for claims adjudication, eligibility verification, and annual benefits plan loading.

Performed daily validation of batch enrollment, billing, and 834/837 EDI transaction files, identifying and documenting errors in coordination with internal enrollment teams and external payer trading partners to maintain 99%+ file acceptance rates.

Assisted in the development and support of HL7 interfaces for clinical applications, working with data analysts and HIM teams to create data mapping documents and maintain interface specifications across 3 major integration projects.

Defined reporting specifications for Medicare Advantage federal regulatory submissions, coordinating with compliance and actuarial teams to validate data accuracy before quarterly CMS submissions.

Coordinated UAT for 4 quarterly system releases covering claims configuration updates and enrollment processing enhancements, managing 100+ test scenarios and 22 defects through resolution in JIRA with full RTM traceability.



Associate Healthcare Business Analyst	                                                                    August 2016 - February 2019

Parkland Health & Hospital System | Dallas, TX

Supported the claims processing and enrollment operations team at Parkland Health, Dallas County's public safety-net hospital system serving 1 million+ patient visits annually. Worked on 837 claims processing, 834 enrollment transactions, and benefits configuration validation for Medicaid, CHIP, and uncompensated care populations. Reported to the Manager of Claims and Billing Systems.



Gathered business requirements from claims supervisors, enrollment coordinators, and IT stakeholders for claims processing and enrollment system enhancements, converting requirements into detailed BRDs with acceptance criteria for the development team.

Worked on 837 claims and 834 enrollment EDI transactions, validating transaction accuracy for Medicaid and CHIP populations by running SQL queries to compare submitted claims against eligibility records and flagging discrepancies for resolution.

Performed gap analysis on benefits configuration rules by comparing Texas HHSC Medicaid contract requirements against system settings, identifying 25+ configuration discrepancies across copay schedules, covered service categories, and prior authorization requirements.

Built SQL queries against the claims data warehouse to audit test claims for correct processing, validating adjudication outcomes against expected results for 5 major payer categories and documenting exceptions for the configuration team.

Created and maintained the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) linking business requirements to design documents, test plans, and test cases, ensuring full traceability across 3 concurrent projects.

Assisted the QA team in developing UAT test cases and scripts, supported SMEs in UAT execution, and documented user feedback from claims, enrollment, and billing stakeholders for sprint backlog prioritization.

eDUCATION



Bachelor of Education 

Punjab University, India (2000)

Certified Scrum Master (CSM) - Scrum Alliance
